pipelineNotes: All family artwork newly generated from the accepted pastel squirrel style target; no color-only reuse of old animal artwork.
All four views separately generated through direction/state anchors and canonical extraction/composition.
Copied squirrel idle rows with a differing key were reconciled using canonical cutout, then canonical extract/compose.
Grain background haze was removed by canonical slice-sheet alpha-floor64, preserving solid/edge pixels.
Bamboo normalized by canonical resize_cell with6px top margin and180px foot baseline.
RGBA lossless exact export checked by asset owners; parent independently checked distinct frames, alpha margins, image dimensions and SHA256.

motionReview.contact: All20 six-frame work rows use600ms cycles, index3 contact at330ms. Runtime retains the same direction/timing rules.
motionReview.scale: Fixed view and state ready-body-height corrections; no per-frame image warps.
knownLimits: Redpanda left harvest has a minor collar-star count change and a few low bamboo leaves; not a facing/anatomy failure.
Bear front/right eye highlights can read warmer than its other poses.
Short six-frame cycles can show minor shape changes; exact same-foot contact across all transitions and real mobile-device temporal performance remain unverified.
